name: Agent Performance: custom range survives a reload; dashboard row matches the Stats tab
description: SPEC-10 AC-31 + AC-62. The seeded PR #484 runs (server/src/db/seed-performance.ts) give the Security Reviewer 6 counted runs, $0.05, 6.2s, 71% and 5/7 decided in 2026-09-01..2026-09-30. Two agent-browser quirks shape the steps: (1) `fill` on a native <input type=date> leaves the value empty (Apply stays disabled, observed 2026-10-17), so the dates are set with the native value setter plus an `input` event, which reaches React's onChange like a real edit; (2) `find role link --name` does not match the row's aria-labelled View link although the accessibility snapshot lists it, so that link is clicked by its aria-label attribute. The window is restored by a fresh `open` (no reload command) and carried to the agent Stats tab through the row's View link. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).

steps.label: the labelled Start date input is shown
the labelled End date input is shown

cmd: (() => { const set = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; const [a, b] = document.querySelectorAll('input[type=date]'); set.call(a, '2026-09-01'); a.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); set.call(b, '2026-09-30'); b.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return 'set'; })()
steps.label: set Start date 2026-09-01 and End date 2026-09-30 through the date inputs
the applied window is written to the URL (AC-31)
